13 older statement readings (Microsoft, Nvidia and Applied Digital among them) will be read again on the next extraction run; the golden check must be rerun after.
The Proof board's as-of time is the server's local time, not labelled UTC (the trail's now is).
One green Verified mark stands for five different checks: an SEC XBRL match, a word-for-word quote, statements located, no blocking items and a confirmed category.

A decision on an exception (decisions/decisions.jsonl) records no author and can close a blocking finding: it drops off Proof, gate G4 and Reconcile whoever wrote it. 12 current accepts on blocks are by "Claude Code, for Kenny Geiler to confirm" (FCX, HUT, LITE, NRG, SYM, TLN, VST, outside the scope today); no gate counts them as left to confirm.
where: review.decide, review.open_items; proof.company decided; release.gates G4; decisions/decisions.jsonl

text: A reviewer decision keeps counting on Proof, the Release open count, the API status and the taxonomy rows after the item it was written for changed; only Reconcile reopens it. On those pages two items on one row share one decision: accepting a fact changed since the release, or a big move, closes the fact or value that still differs from SEC data.
where: resolutions.by_row without items; resolutions._parse; proof.company; api status; taxonomy.rows

text: The check that every verified or explained row names a record that exists runs only in a test on the frozen fixtures, never on the live data, on a page or on the Release checklist.

A note figure whose filing's XBRL instance was never loaded reads as unverified, citation only, the same as one whose instance tags nothing; no tie or second reading is tried and nothing says the lookup did not run.
where: status.of_fact no_reference; ties.load; ties.instance_totals; notes label

text: The release signature, every reviewer decision, gold verdict and mapping from a page are recorded under the name in the signer box, which is filled with Kenny Geiler by default; the signature's name is not checked against the people list at all.
where: checklist.sign by; cli signoff --by; pages/_shared.js me default

text: A release can be signed and published while the hosted copy serves an older release or unknown code; the hosted copy's state only informs (Known gaps) and is not a step of signing.

The Release can be signed with the test suite not run, or run on another commit or a dirty tree (both only inform), and with a golden report from older code: the golden report records no commit and its line never reads stale; gold verdicts given after the last golden run are not reflected.

Nothing says when the local app runs older code than the checkout: pages load new scripts on every request while the server keeps the code it started with, and Reconcile's queue cache does not refresh after decisions, the EDGAR check, rules, definitions or mappings change.

The dataset page marks any row it does not recognise with a check mark, "checked, no tagged counterpart to agree with", including note figures whose readings differ (open on Proof); the trail's Needs review stands for both open and blocked, and Unverified or citation only for every kind of explanation, a reviewer's decision included.
where: pages/data.js mark; pages/trail.js TRAIL_TONE; cards.status_line reading_only

text: Reconcile's new filings come from the EDGAR check file with no age and are never matched against filings read since, so a filing already read stays listed as not ingested; a new filing can also be accepted away on Reconcile while unread.
where: app._flow new_filing; hq.snapshot watch; cards.add unread; resolutions.LIVE_KINDS new_filing

text: A publish that succeeds from the command line after a failed one from the page leaves the release recorded as not published, and the Proof releases table keeps saying so; releases signed before publishing was recorded show nothing either way.
Project readings load even when they answered an older task (no task fingerprint check on load), and statement, note and AI readings with no fingerprint load while the run step re-asks them.
The gold table's live open mark reads a note figure without the ladder, so it can disagree with the golden check for the same figure.
The packet's README says the status column holds empty, confirmed, overridden or rejected; it holds accepted, explained, fix_pending or blocks.
Proven means three things: a company in the proven set (the API and packet column), a company with nothing open (Proof and the trail), and a claim's status.
where: api proven column; release.COLUMN_DOCS proven; proof.company proven; claims STATUSES

text: An as-of figure not compared with its own filing reads unchecked in the values list and not_checked in the taxonomy list.
The reviewer decisions, the resolutions and the mapping proposals are called append-only but nothing checks it; only the findings log is checked.

40 of NVIDIA's 48 property-category cells are not located on the rendered 10-K: their column labels end with the useful-life sub-header ((In years), Property and Equipment:), so the locator reads the wrong column and refuses. No crop is shown for them.
where: note_extractions ppe_category NVDA t0042/t0038 column_label; reports/evidence/crops.json
